reason: Main 5cbb165 adds test_capture_and_restore.py::TestCalendarCaptureRestore::test_calendar_capture_on_delete. Its haos_only and external_only markers restrict the test to external HAOS, so it adds one collection-time skip on each other lane. The container CI observed 107 marker-skipped tests against the previous ceiling of 106 on both amd64 and aarch64. Native lane variants inherit these increments; the baseline and all existing fragments remain unchanged.
